import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variants in species and island
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (remove any non-numeric characters)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas and convert)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Drop rows with missing sex (as per rule: missing means unknown; do not guess)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex', observed=True)['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2)
    
    # Convert to dictionary with keys as 'male', 'female', and 'all' for overall
    return {k: v for k, v in result.items()}
